topic: Science inventions and their everyday life impacts
key_concepts: Science inventions are found at home and in the local community.
Common examples include rice cookers, mobile phones, refrigerators, computers, and kitchen
Inventions make daily activities like cooking, communicating, and transporting easier and
Before inventions, people used slower methods like walking long distances, writing letters
Mobile phones allow fast and easy communication with family and friends.
Kitchen appliances like rice cookers and stoves make cooking quicker and more convenient.
Medicines and medical tools help diagnose diseases and provide immediate treatment.
Inventions can have negative effects if misused, such as laziness, pollution, and health i
Responsible use and information literacy help maximize benefits and minimize harm.
Technology has transformed how people prepare food, build houses, communicate, and travel.
Comparing life with and without inventions shows their impact on everyday life.
